excluded_paper_components: The source uses a large equity universe, many firm characteristics, monthly returns, validation-selected hyperparameters and multiple model families; this sample fixes two synthetic characteristics, three symbols, daily returns and one declared penalty.

The implementation uses coordinate descent for the same elastic-net objective instead of the paper's accelerated proximal gradient solver. It does not implement Huber loss or report paper performance.
The reference engine emits paired target positions after all three daily closes and fills each symbol separately at its next opening; it does not guarantee atomic portfolio rebalancing.

steps.adaptation: The source uses a large equity universe, many firm characteristics, monthly returns, validation-selected hyperparameters and multiple model families; this sample fixes two synthetic characteristics, three symbols, daily returns and one declared penalty.
steps.paper_rule: Elastic net combines absolute-value and squared-coefficient penalties.
steps.runtime_rule: Fit the fixed elastic-net objective by a soft-threshold coordinate update.

steps.adaptation: The implementation uses coordinate descent for the same elastic-net objective instead of the paper's accelerated proximal gradient solver. It does not implement Huber loss or report paper performance.
steps.paper_rule: Forecast-sorted portfolios take long high-prediction stocks and short low-prediction stocks.
steps.runtime_rule: Rank a complete daily panel of forecasts and target the highest and lowest symbols.
